sourceChecks.text: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

sourceChecks.text: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

sourceChecks.text: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

sourceChecks.text: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

sourceChecks.text: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

sourceChecks.text: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

sourceChecks.text: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

sourceChecks.text: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
